set.body: Plan: (1) add a typed core LSS matrix API in scalafim-fmri-fit; (2) add portable QR residualization support for fixed/nuisance columns; (3) implement the closed-form LSS kernel over residualized trial regressors and response blocks; (4) verify against explicit per-trial OLS and fmrilss semantics; (5) defer OASIS, SBHM, voxel-specific HRFs, AR/prewhitening, ridge, stglmnet, and ITEM until the dense core is coherent.
set.title: Port core fmrilss LSS estimator
